reviewer_role: Non-author read-only review of new runtime/training/inference/evaluation implementations; changes made by their authors/root
scope: Experimental fairness, source admission, labels/token budgets, complete denominators, account identity, runtime accounting, registered statistics. No old-model experiment rerun.

findings.finding: Paired evaluator requested pair_training_settings while training produced paired_settings, so formal A/C comparison would reject valid runs.
findings.resolution: Unified paired_settings binding; evaluator verifies referenced settings schema, preparation and training environment.

findings.finding: Generation originally trusted a self-declared frozen manifest; a reduced or rewritten evaluation population could be accepted.
findings.resolution: Parent and supplement manifests must match the existing public frozen SHA identities before question/catalog loading. Complete ordered coverage is required again in offline scoring.

findings.finding: Adapter completion proof initially did not bind the base config/tokenizer used at generation to the base used during training.
findings.resolution: Generation verifies the actual base-directory identity against the training completion result; A/C comparison also matches generated base identity.

findings.finding: Matching configured training settings alone did not ensure equal actual software versions, numerical settings and generation implementation.
findings.resolution: Same-seed paired settings lock actual training environment before second arm; run results record it. Comparator matches training environment, global steps, target tokens, sampled order, initial files, actual inference versions, dtype/attention, batch/seed/decoding and generation implementation SHA. Separate continuation seeds have separate settings bindings.

findings.finding: getpass.getuser could use LOGNAME/USER rather than the actual uid account, allowing ubuntu to be misidentified as syx.
findings.resolution: Use pwd.getpwuid(euid).pw_name, reject root/ubuntu and mismatched ordinary account, with environment-spoof regression.

findings.finding: Initial paired aggregator omitted the original24 task contract question-paired bootstrap, returning only exact counts.
findings.resolution: For holdout24, read the unchanged bound task contract and run 5000 paired-question bootstrap replicates with seed20261107. Composition12 remains a separate descriptive population.

findings.finding: A per-ledger limit alone relied on callers choosing one common ledger; changing config paths could reset apparent round allowance.
findings.resolution: Production training config and runtime/generation entry points enforce the registered shared ledger through require_round_ledger. Temporary isolated ledgers remain available only to lower-level CPU unit tests.

findings.finding: Frozen TableExecutor let Decimal InvalidOperation and AttributeError escape for malformed numeric/columns/conditions model JSON. Actual read-only reproduction showed calls=2 but only one recorded event, so a model mistake could abort the dataset run instead of becoming recoverable tool feedback.
findings.resolution: Versioned TableRuntimeExecutor delegates valid operations unchanged and normalizes only DecimalException, AttributeError and OverflowError into stable ValueError tool feedback. New inference, offline replay/scoring and training recovery construction all use and hash-bind the adapter; frozen executor and data remain unchanged.
code: table_training RuntimeExecutor alias and CODE binding

malformed_cases: Project columns list instead of mapping
Scan conditions list instead of mapping

findings.finding: Generation previously wrote completed before JobBudget finalization; a watchdog hard exit in that interval could leave a completed manifest with a timed_out allocation job.
findings.resolution: While inside JobBudget, generation now writes outputs_written_budget_finalization_pending. After the budget context exits, it checks the matching job is completed, binds its stable per-job digest, and only then writes completed. Formal scoring requires one matching completed job and the same digest; concurrent addition of other jobs does not invalidate an existing completed job.
checked_control_flow: All model output and weight cleanup occur before JobBudget exit
The only success status assignment follows verified completed ledger job
Watchdog termination before context completion leaves a non-completed manifest
Formal scoring rejects a claimed success when ledger status or stable job digest differs

checked_invariants: Training preparation opens only the hash-bound576 synthetic train examples; dev/holdout/supplement cannot be relabelled into this partition.
Initial success trajectories are actually replayed, tokenized with the pinned tokenizer, and packed with assistant-only labels; reference/tool/input content is masked.

Formal recovery preparation requires a completed actual I_domain training result and full ordered model-generated train rollout manifest, then replays observations/answers and constructs the first reference divergence.
CPU fixture generators remain cpu_fixture and training_eligible=false; production scoring and recovery admission reject them.

Ordinary examples are byte-identical between A/C; paired suffixes match source IDs, sample order and supervised-token counts; exact component budgets use target masking without shortening input history.
A/C share their collecting I_domain model files and actual configuration; initial and continuation run identities are explicit.

Inference stops at context/call/generated-token budgets without input truncation; failures remain in complete split order; unexpected backend failures abort with partial artifacts rather than silently removing questions.
Offline scoring replays messages/events, checks submitted answer/handle, actual token IDs and full-history counts; synthetic/real dev and basic24/composition12 are separately grouped.

Runtime gate checks a real ordinary Linux uid, current device occupancy, current binding hashes and a recent CUDA tensor probe; actual model-forward or training forward/backward smoke happens inside the charged job.
Shared allocation ledger reserves concurrent budgets, charges loading/compute/model-saving wall time, rejects duplicate jobs and has an in-process hard timeout watchdog without touching foreign PIDs.
Model loading is local_files_only; CPU import/help and fixtures do not download weights or invoke GPU model code.

Malformed model operation configs produce counted, replayable tool errors without allocating a result handle; subsequent valid calls and recovery suffix construction continue. Only the three declared parameter-error exception families are normalized; infrastructure exceptions propagate.

Actual model generation success requires completed GPU allocation accounting and a bound stable per-job digest; timed_out/running/duplicate/digest-mismatched jobs cannot be scored as completed model results.

final_cpu_tests.scope: Current five runtime modules including new budget-terminal regression; no model run.

original_24_statistics.supplement_policy: Separate exact paired and source-family counts; never pooled as new independent families

gpu_validation.reason: Local registered weights/adapters absent and local environments have no torch; actual Linux/CUDA runtime smoke is still required.

next_validation: On restored ordinary-account Linux CUDA runtime, verify original assets, perform the registered current device/model smoke, then run explicit bounded jobs. CPU success is preparation evidence, not measured model performance.
revision_scope: Append only the requested generation/job-budget terminal consistency review and refresh final hashes/test counts. Previous R1-R8 findings unchanged.
